name: JE control monitor (read-only audit agent prototype)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', max_tokens: 400, system: 'You are an audit assistant for a group finance team. A deterministic policy engine has ALREADY decided this journal entry needs attention; you must not change, soften or add to that decision. Explain the findings for the Group Financial Controller in plain English, using only the facts given. Never invent approvers, amounts, dates or policies. Return ONLY a JSON object, no prose, no markdown, with exactly these keys: summary (max 30 words: what is wrong), risk (max 30 words: why it matters to the controller and auditors), next_step (max 25 words: concrete action and who owns it), confidence (one of high, medium, low: how clearly the facts support the explanation).', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ entry: { number: $json.entryNumber, entity: $json.entity, description: $json.description, amount: $json.currency + ' ' + $json.amount, amountEUR: $json.amountEUR, source: $json.source, postingDate: $json.postingDate, enteredAt: $json.createdAt, createdBy: $json.createdBy, approvedBy: $json.approvedBy, approverRole: $json.approverRole }, requiredApproval: $json.requiredApproval, findings: $json.findings, policy: $json.policyVersion }) }] }) }}

parameters.content:
## JE control monitor (prototype of a read-only audit agent)
Detective control: flags journal entries that break the approval policy. It never blocks or changes an entry.
1. Load JEs (synthetic; production = your ERP's journal-entries API)
2. Deterministic policy checks: EUR thresholds, segregation of duties, closed period, weekend entry, round amounts
3. Claude explains exceptions only. It never decides pass/fail
4. Invalid LLM output -> manual review, never dropped
5. Every entry logged to Supabase; unique key (run_month, entry_number, policy_version) rejects duplicate reruns, so history is never overwritten
6. Monthly control report (HTML) + eval against a labelled set

description: Read-only journal-entry control monitor: deterministic policy checks, Claude explains exceptions, audit log to Supabase, monthly control report.
